 Learn more Market Hang's panel discusses SpaceX ( SPCX ) CEO Elon Musk's reported push into the telecom business and the short-term upside if he actually pursues the idea. 
 Host and "The Buy Side" author Turney Duff is joined by Mike Rode, Chief Investment Strategist at FAS Wealth Partners; Kyla Scanlon, host of Vox's "Best of Luck" and author of "In This Economy"; Conor Sen, founder of The Housing Frame; and Sarah Kunst, Managing Director at Cleo Capital

And best-case scenario, he only has two more years of avoiding, right? And so these aren't very lucrative businesses.
